title: Assign a wire value for the L2 SOS dispatch type referenced by 04-network.md §6.3.3
description: 04-network.md §6.3.3 SOS detection now requires a link-layer dispatch marker (packet.l2_dispatch == L2_DISPATCH_SOS) so relays can identify SOS traffic for the separate 3/hour SOS budget (the CoAP /sos path is unusable — OSCORE encrypts Uri-Path end-to-end and SCHC elides it). No wire value is assigned in 02-physical-link.md for an SOS L2 dispatch type; C code carries LICHEN_L2_DISPATCH_SOS (0x16) in-tree but that constant was never specified in the link-layer spec. Assign and document the value in 02-physical-link.md (dispatch table) and cross-reference 03-adaptation.md if SCHC must not elide it. Discovered via cl56 codereview (pass 1 finding 2, pass 3 finding 1).
